features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
My Media: favorite stations, your shows, your audiobooks and history, filtered by kind
Every OndaCast station by listeners or genre, with the song on air and its artwork
Resume episodes and books where you left off, with smart rewind and chapter progress
Your week: time listened per day, by kind, and your listening streak
Custom skip intervals, sleep timer, speed per show, keyboard shortcuts and a reorderable queue
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
TEND Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.2.0: My Media, a library of favorite stations, subscribed shows and your audiobooks, filterable by kind; hearts to favorite stations and save books; a Your week listening summary with streaks; playback preferences (skip intervals, smart rewind, continuous play); keyboard shortcuts; drag to reorder Up next.
